title: The Unsolved Murder Where the Killer Left a Confession on a Victim's Phone—As a Ringtone
hook: Detectives found the killer's full name and confession hidden as a custom ringtone on the victim's phone, but no one noticed for three years.
why_this_can_go_viral: People love tech-related murder mysteries, and the idea of a clue hiding in plain sight as a ringtone is deeply unsettling and intriguing.

title: The Criminal Mastermind Who Robbed 12 Banks Using a Single Fake Phone Call
hook: He never entered a single bank. A single phone call tricked managers into wiring millions, all by impersonating a CEO with a cloned voice.
why_this_can_go_viral: The audacity and simplicity of using a single call to rob banks is shocking and showcases a criminal genius at work.
